method: atlas-systemizer atlas pack of the G147 tree (release build); publish encodes, decodes and requires the decoded container equal to the packaged state before the atomic rename; the runtime self-census test asserts the packaged typed records equal the census list (all twelve families) and the evidence and diagnostic counts
size_note: the container grew from 5.7 MB to 114.0 MB uncompressed: the wire's record framing costs 8 bytes per field and 8 per record, embedded records included; the string table holds 568,747 strings; compression (ZSTD, contract-pinned but refused by this reader) is deferred
fixture_tests: 31 typed records of all twelve families (largest and smallest of each, both PlaceRef variants, present and absent optional fields, a projection), their evidence, one evidence record without a revision, diagnostics with and without a dimension: byte-deterministic round trip; no record's serde text in the container; per-byte corruption and truncation of a compact typed sample all rejected (the minor bytes included)
adversarial: a fact after the typed records rejected
an embedded-only kind at top level rejected
a dangling evidence reference refused at write and rejected at read
a boolean byte other than 0 or 1 rejected
an embedded record of another kind rejected
a changed field shape does not conform

cases: absent sequence not decoded as empty
dangling evidence accepted by the reader
embedded kind accepted at top level

intended_change: benchmark B20 (G146) asserted atlas_of reads no typed_semantic_records; G147 packages them, so B20 now expects census.typed_semantic_records, census.evidence and census.diagnostics among atlas_of's field reads
dependency: core gains serde_json (pure serialization, already in the workspace build through runtime and adapter); declared in the recensus intent
deferred: identity/type/symbol interning tables (identities inline through the string table)
test_cost: the runtime test suite takes 285 s (about 115 s at G146): its self-census pack test encodes and decodes 151k typed records in a debug build; the core container tests take 9 s after the per-byte batteries moved to a compact typed sample
